---
name: WOGHAW E-02 audit (codex)
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      wo_operation_id:
        description: WO operation_id
        required: true
        type: string
      wo_attempt_id:
        description: WO attempt_id
        required: true
        type: string
  push:
    branches: [woghaw-phase3-targets]
if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
run-name: "WOGHAW E-02 ${{ inputs.wo_operation_id }} ${{ inputs.wo_attempt_id }} audit codex"
permissions:
  contents: read
engine:
  id: codex
  max-turns: 3
  harness:
    max-retries: 0
  env:
    GH_AW_HARNESS_STARTUP_RETRIES: "0"
max-ai-credits: 30
timeout-minutes: 5
tools:
  bash: false
  cli-proxy: false
  edit: false
  github: false
safe-outputs:
  github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
  report-failure-as-issue: false
  report-failed-jobs: false
  noop:
    report-as-issue: false
  missing-tool:
    create-issue: false
  missing-data:
    create-issue: false
  report-incomplete:
    create-issue: false
  threat-detection: false
  jobs:
    wo-result:
      description: "Report the single result value of this WO task. It performs no action other than recording the value."
      runs-on: ubuntu-latest
      permissions: {}
      output: "recorded"
      inputs:
        value:
          description: "The result value"
          required: true
          type: string
      steps:
        - name: WO result (no GitHub effect)
          run: |
            v=$(jq -c '[.items[] | select(.type == "wo_result") | .value]' "$GH_AW_AGENT_OUTPUT" 2>/dev/null || echo '"unreadable"')
            echo "::notice title=WO_E02_RESULT::{\"wd_id\":\"WD-E02-SLUG-REVIEW\",\"wd_sha256\":\"3c6ba023611172762b686b48f68c7cf5fe871239da0f13e2c9c607e7ed143413\",\"role\":\"audit\",\"engine\":\"codex\",\"values\":$v}"
jobs:
  wo_evidence:
    needs: [agent]
    if: always() && needs.agent.result != 'skipped'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: {}
    steps:
      - name: WO E-02 agent job evidence
        env:
          WO_AGENT_RESULT: ${{ needs.agent.result }}
          WO_AGENT_AIC: ${{ needs.agent.outputs.aic }}
          WO_AGENT_MODEL: ${{ needs.agent.outputs.model }}
          WO_ATTEMPT_ID: ${{ inputs.wo_attempt_id }}
        run: echo "::notice title=WO_E02_AGENT_JOB::{\"attempt_id\":\"${WO_ATTEMPT_ID}\",\"role\":\"audit\",\"engine\":\"codex\",\"agent_result\":\"${WO_AGENT_RESULT}\",\"aic\":\"${WO_AGENT_AIC}\",\"model\":\"${WO_AGENT_MODEL}\"}"
---

# WD-E02-SLUG-REVIEW — role `audit`

This is a controlled validation run. You have no shell, no file editing and no GitHub tools; do not try to use any.

Input text: `Hello, World  Example`

Rule: lowercase; replace every run of characters that are not a-z or 0-9 with a single hyphen; strip leading and trailing hyphens.

Task: Independently check whether the candidate slug `hello-world-example` is exactly the result of applying the rule to the input text.

Result: PASS if it is exactly correct, otherwise FAIL.

Call the safe-output tool `wo_result` exactly once with `value` set to the result, then stop. Do not call any other tool.
